question.text: Which of the following ketone will NOT give enamine on treatment with secondary amines? [where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>Bu</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mfenced><msub><mi>CH</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></mfenced><mn>3</mn></msub></math>]

solution.text: Due to absence of alpha hydrogen it does not give enamine on reaction with 2 degree amine. All other molecules has alpha hydrogen present.
